name: wealthcore
description: WealthCore - Your Entire Financial Life. One Intelligent Core. A private, personal financial operating system.

scripts.lint: node --check server/index.js && node --check server/routes/api.js && node --check server/lib/*.js && node --check server/db/*.js && node --check server/config.js
scripts.audit:secrets: grep -rInE 'API_KEY|SECRET|PASSWORD|PRIVATE_KEY|BEGIN (RSA|EC|OPENSSH) PRIVATE' server public --include='*.js' | grep -vE 'WEALTHCORE_|process\\.env|password_hash|password_salt|session|Bearer|token,|req\\.body|headers\\.authorization|NO_SECRET_CONFIGURED|credentials required|READY_FOR_CONFIGURATION' || echo 'No hard-coded secrets found.'
